scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dzgrid/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && ngc -p packages/angular/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && node scripts/typecheck-grid.mjs
scripts.pack:local: npm run build && rm -rf packed && mkdir packed && for p in core angular theme dzgrid; do (cd packages/$p/dist && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../packed >/dev/null) || exit 1; done && ls packed
scripts.release:check: npm run pack:local && npm run check:size && npm run check:api && node scripts/release.mjs check && node scripts/entries.mjs
scripts.publish:latest: npm run build && node scripts/release.mjs publish
